text:
We’re looking for an ERPNext / Frappe developer to join our team and take ownership of ongoing development, customizations, integrations, and maintenance.
You should have hands-on experience using AI coding agents such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, or equivalent tools as part of your development workflow. We want someone who can guide these tools effectively, review their output, and take responsibility for the finished code.
What you’ll do

Develop and maintain custom Frappe applications and ERPNext functionality.

Build DocTypes, workflows, reports, dashboards, and print formats.

Integrate ERPNext with external platforms through APIs and webhooks.

Diagnose bugs, improve performance, and maintain existing customizations.

Use AI coding agents to support implementation, debugging, refactoring, testing, and documentation.

Review generated code for correctness, security, maintainability, and compatibility with our ERPNext version.

Work through Git, staging environments, and a clear release process.

Communicate progress, flag blockers, and clarify requirements before making assumptions.

Requirements
What we’re looking for

Proven ERPNext / Frappe development experience beyond installation and configuration.

Strong Python, JavaScript, and SQL skills.

Experience with Frappe permissions, document events, background jobs, and migrations.

Practical experience using AI coding agents on real development projects.

Ability to understand an existing codebase and debug code independently.

Experience with Git, Linux, and deploying or maintaining Frappe applications.

Clear written and spoken English.

Availability for agreed working-hour overlap with our team on Eastern Time (ET).

Useful additional experience

ERPNext manufacturing, inventory, purchasing, and accounting workflows.

Vue.js and custom Frappe interfaces.

Docker, automated testing, and CI/CD.

Benefits
Location: Remote - Latin America preferred; candidates based in India also welcome
Commitment: Full-time, long-term
Budget: Around USD $2,000 per month, depending on experience
How to apply
Please send:

A summary of your ERPNext / Frappe experience, including versions and modules you’ve worked with.

Two relevant projects, explaining your specific contribution. GitHub links or code samples are welcome.

Which AI coding agents you use and an example of how you used one to deliver an ERPNext / Frappe feature.

An example of incorrect code an AI agent produced, how you identified the issue, and how you fixed it.

Your location, time zone, start date, and expected monthly compensation.

Confirmation that you’re available for a full-time role.

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a technical discussion. You’re encouraged to use your usual AI coding tools during the task and explain your approach, review decisions, and validation.

title: AI Automation Expert (n8n / Make / Zapier / AI Agents)
text:
Kreative Media is hiring an AI Automation Expert to build the workflows behind our AI creative pipeline and client operations. You will design n8n, Make and Zapier automations and AI agents that turn a brief into production-ready creative faster.
Location: Remote (open to candidates in India and worldwide). Company HQ: New Delhi, India.
Employment type: Full-time (contract-to-hire possible)
Responsibilities:

Design, build and maintain automations in n8n (including self-hosted), Make and Zapier

Build AI agents and LLM workflows with OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini APIs: brief parsing, prompt generation, scoring and reporting

Connect creative tools (Kling, Midjourney, ElevenLabs and others) and business apps (Google Workspace, Notion, Slack, CRMs, Meta Ads) through APIs and webhooks

Automate client onboarding, asset delivery and performance reporting

Document workflows, monitor failures and keep costs under control

Scope automation projects for clients with the CEO and the creative team

Requirements:

2+ years building production automations in n8n, Make or Zapier

Comfortable with REST APIs, webhooks, JSON and JavaScript or Python

Experience building LLM or AI-agent workflows (tool calling, RAG or similar)

Can map a business process before automating it

Clear written English and dependable remote collaboration

Nice to have:

Docker or VPS self-hosting

Vector databases (Pinecone, Qdrant, Supabase)

Experience with ad-platform APIs (Meta, Google Ads)

Salary:

India: ₹60,000 – ₹125,000 per month (INR), based on experience

Global/US remote: US$7,000 – US$11,000 per month, based on experience and location

How to apply: Email  with the subject "AI Automation Expert (n8n / Make / Zapier / AI Agents) — Kreative Media". Include your CV, portfolio or links to your work, and your notice period.
About Kreative Media:
Kreative Media () is an AI-powered creative agency based in New Delhi, India, producing high-performance marketing creatives for modern brands: AI video ads with AI avatars and voices, AI static ads, and brand-aligned creative built with specialized AI workflows (Midjourney, Kling, Seedance). Jitendra Vaswani is the investor and CEO of Kreative Media. He is also the founder of BloggersIdeas, AffiliateBooster, SchemaNinja and DigiExe, and has spent more than a decade in SEO, affiliate and digital marketing. Our process: a 30-minute brief, AI generation and scoring, brand-polish editing, then production-ready files with a testing playbook. We work remotely with brands in India and around the world.

title: NetSuite ERP Developer
text:
1. Role Overview
The NetSuite ERP Developer (C11) is a n intermediate technical role responsible for designing, developing, testing, deploying, and maintaining customizations, integrations, and enhancements within Oracle NetSuite ERP. Working within enterprise financial architecture, the role bridges complex financial/business workflows and scalable software engineering practices.
At the C11 level, the candidate is expected to act as an individual contributor and subject matter expert, leading technical solution designs, mentoring junior team members, enforcing standard development lifecycles (SDLC), and driving end-to-end integration with upstream and downstream enterprise systems.
2. Key Responsibilities
Technical Design & SuiteCloud Development

Architect, develop, and maintain advanced NetSuite customizations using SuiteScript (1.0 / 2.0 / 2.1) across Client Scripts, User Event Scripts, Scheduled Scripts, Map/Reduce Scripts, Suitelets, and RESTlets.

Create and optimize custom workflows using SuiteFlow, custom records, custom fields, sublists, forms, and custom segments.

Build, deploy, and support SuiteBuilder configurations and tailored UI enhancements to support multi-subsidiary, multi-currency financial operations (OneWorld).

Design robust data models, complex saved searches, financial reports, SuiteAnalytics workbooks, and advanced PDF/HTML templates.

Systems Integration & Data Pipelines

Develop, monitor, and troubleshoot bi-directional REST / SOAP APIs and web services connecting NetSuite with external platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Banking/Payment Gateways, HRIS, Data Lakes, Enterprise Middleware like Boomi, MuleSoft, or Celigo).

Handle large-scale financial data migration, batch ETL jobs, and automated synchronization across billing, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and general ledger modules.

Implement error handling, transaction retry mechanisms, and automated logging for mission-critical financial interfaces.

Governance, Security & Release Management

Manage development, sandbox, and production environments using SuiteCloud Development Framework (SDF), Git version control, and automated CI/CD deployment pipelines.

Ensure strict adherence to enterprise information security, SOX compliance, segregation of duties (SoD), role-based permissions, and audit trail standards.

Conduct code reviews, establish coding standards, ensure proper governance of NetSuite execution governance limits, and optimize script performance/queue management.

Stakeholder Collaboration & Agile Delivery

Partner with Business Analysts, Financial Systems Architects, and Accounting/Finance business partners to translate complex business requirements into technical specifications.

Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Backlog Refinement, Retrospectives).

Provide tier-3 production support, investigate critical defects, and resolve release upgrade compatibility issues (NetSuite bi-annual releases).

3. Qualifications & Technical Competencies
Required Technical Skills

NetSuite Platform: 5–8+ years of hands-on experience with NetSuite ERP development and administration (OneWorld preferred).

SuiteScript Proficiency: Expert-level mastery of SuiteScript 2.0 / 2.1 (TypeScript/JavaScript ES6+).

Web & Scripting Languages: Strong proficiency in JavaScript/Node.js, HTML5, CSS, JSON, XML, and FreeMarker.

Integrations: Proven track record of developing custom RESTlets, SuiteTalk (SOAP/REST Web Services), and integrating via iPaaS tools (e.g., Dell Boomi, Celigo, MuleSoft).

Database & Querying: In-depth knowledge of SuiteQL, SQL, relational database design, and query optimization.

DevOps & Source Control: Experience with Git, Bitbucket/GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, and NetSuite SDF (SuiteCloud Development Framework).

NetSuite Functional Knowledge

Deep understanding of core ERP and financial modules:

○ Order-to-Cash (O2C)
○ Procure-to-Pay (P2P)
○ Record-to-Report (R2R)
○ Revenue Recognition (ARM / Advanced Rev
